pwm_pin.label: PWM Pin (BCM)
pwm_pin.description: The Pi GPIO wired to this channel's PWMA/PWMB. Assigned by the deploy.

in1_pin.label: IN1 Pin (BCM)
in1_pin.description: The Pi GPIO wired to AIN1/BIN1. Assigned by the deploy.

in2_pin.label: IN2 Pin (BCM)
in2_pin.description: The Pi GPIO wired to AIN2/BIN2. Assigned by the deploy.

stby_pin.label: STBY Pin (BCM)
stby_pin.description: Optional. Leave empty and wire STBY to 3.3 V.

max_speed_rad_s.label: Speed at Full Duty (rad/s)
max_speed_rad_s.description: The joint's speed at 100% duty, which maps a Motor Controller's speed command to duty. The deploy fills it in from the joint's top speed.

min_duty.label: Minimum Duty
min_duty.description: Duty below which the motor doesn't turn (0–1); commands above zero start here.

brake_on_stop.label: Brake on Stop
brake_on_stop.description: Short-brake the motor at zero instead of letting it coast.

step_pin.label: STEP Pin (BCM)
step_pin.description: The Pi GPIO wired to the driver's STEP. Assigned by the deploy.

dir_pin.label: DIR Pin (BCM)
dir_pin.description: The Pi GPIO wired to the driver's DIR. Assigned by the deploy.

enable_pin.label: EN Pin (BCM)
enable_pin.description: Optional, active low. Leave empty and wire EN to GND (always energized).

steps_per_rev.label: Full Steps per Revolution
steps_per_rev.description: 200 for a 1.8° motor, 400 for a 0.9° one.

microsteps.label: Microsteps
microsteps.description: What the driver's MS pins are set to. The build instructions set them to 1/16.

gear_ratio.label: Reduction
gear_ratio.description: Motor turns per joint turn (gearbox × belt/gears). Filled in by the deploy.

zero_on_start.label: Zero at Power-On
zero_on_start.description: The joint reads 0 where it sat at start-up. Start the robot in its zero pose.

signal_pin.label: Signal Pin (BCM)
signal_pin.description: The Pi GPIO the servo's signal wire is on. Assigned by the deploy.
